text: heres one for you, this clearly has at atlas because ive painted on it before [Image #1] but it isnt showing because i guess i have not in this session clicked on the paint button, which is kinda a silly way to be the means of loading the atlas for one that already exists
resolution: Moved persisted model-paint restoration out of Paint-tool activation and into the model document-load lifecycle. Existing raster/program atlases and legacy saved variants now hydrate and publish to the UV inspector as soon as their model becomes active, while Paint only changes input mode. Tightened hot-session atlas truth so automatic blank layouts cannot masquerade as authored atlases and suppress hydration; stale topology still fails closed.
